# stackhero_redis (Resource)

A Stackhero Redis service. The CLI does not expose instance size or region on read, so drift in those fields cannot be detected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stackhero_redis" "example" {
  stack_id = stackhero_stack.example.id
  instance = "1G"
  region   = "europe"

  configuration_json = jsonencode({
    tlsOnly         = true
    maxMemoryPolicy = "noeviction"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance` (String) Redis instance size, such as `1G`.
- `region` (String) Region identifier, such as `europe`.
- `stack_id` (String) ID of the stack that contains Redis.

### Optional

- `configuration_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON object of managed Redis settings. Removing a managed key requires replacement. Values are sensitive and passed to the CLI in process arguments.
- `organization` (String) Organization name or ID, when needed to resolve the Redis service store.

### Read-Only

- `domain` (String) Redis host name.
- `id` (String) Stackhero service ID.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Generated Redis password. Stored in Terraform state.
